explanation: Composer Akira Ifukube coated the glove in resin and slowed the recording down. He also wrote the film's score, including its famous march. The first Godzilla film came out in Japan in 1954.

claims.text: The roar of Godzilla in the original 1954 film was created by rubbing a resin-coated leather glove along the strings of a double bass and slowing the recording.
Akira Ifukube, the film's composer, created the roar.
Akira Ifukube composed the score of Godzilla, including its march theme.
The first Godzilla film was released in Japan in 1954.
